audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (1) The ability is called Bear Trap on a Rope; the page writes "Beartrap on a Rope" in every one of its ten appearances across both layers. (2) The page describes it backwards: wants.foe[0] says "let it ramp to 2 stacks so it yanks him onto you" and early says "it pulls him onto you". Riot's text is "If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled" — there are no stacks, it is a duration, and the pull moves YOU toward HIM. Separately, Jousting — his 13/12/11/10/9s dash that recasts to dash back through the target — is never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: The direction of the pull is the whole reason Thundering Blow matters here: if the trap yanks you to Kled, knocking him back does not undo the displacement you already ate, so the knockback has to land BEFORE the shackle expires, not after. And Jousting is the missing half of his engage — a reader told his only gap-close is a hook will hold the knockback for the trap and get Jousted on top of anyway, then eat the return dash.
audit.corrected: Name corrected to Bear Trap on a Rope; the shackle described as a duration that yanks you toward him; Jousting named with its cooldown and its recast.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kled.json (Q Bear Trap on a Rope: CD 11/10/9/8/7, range 800, 'If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled'; E Jousting: CD 13/12/11/10/9, range 550, 'Kled dashes... can cast this ability again to dash back through his initial target')

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's commit rule in both layers is "trade around Bear Trap on a Rope's cooldown" and the number is never given, nor is Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'s despite mid saying to bait it.
audit.why: Bear Trap is 11/10/9/8/7s — short enough that 'wait for it' is a ten-second window, not a lane-long plan, and short enough that it comes back inside a single Violent Tendencies cycle. Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140/125/110s with 3500/4000/4500 range, so baiting it once genuinely buys you two-plus minutes and it is also a global-scale roam threat the page never flags. Jousting at 13s rank 1 is the cooldown that actually gates his all-in.
audit.corrected: Bear Trap 11s, Jousting 13s, Violent Tendencies 13s and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! 140s at 3500+ range written into the spikes, mid and cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Jayce 2+ items while content.late opens "This is where he takes over and you have to be honest about it: Kled is a hard scaler" and whys[6] says "He outscales hard". It also gives Jayce Level 1 and Level 6, while whys[0] calls level 1 a straight coin-flip and whys[4] says the level-6 window "evens out".
audit.why: Three stages disagree with the prose sitting directly beneath them, and the worst of the three tells a Jayce with zero defensive stats that the two-item duel is his — in a matchup he loses 48.99%. That is the stage most likely to get someone killed.
audit.corrected: Level 1 and Level 6 to Skill, 2+ items to Kled — Skill, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Skill, Skill, Kled.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] and late both credit Violent Tendencies with "rapid-hits" that shred you, without saying what limits it.
audit.why: Violent Tendencies is massive attack speed for exactly FOUR attacks, with the fourth dealing more damage, on 13/12/11/10/9s. That is a countable window, not a state: survive four autos and his damage falls off a cliff for the next nine seconds. It is also an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell — the burst starts before any spell effect appears on screen.
audit.corrected: The four-attack limit and the 13s cooldown written in, with the reset named as the visual tell.

notes: NAME ERROR: the ability is Bear Trap on a Rope. The page writes "Beartrap on a Rope" in all ten places it appears, across both layers — corrected everywhere I had a writable path. DIRECTION ERROR (worse): early says the trap "pulls him onto you" and wants.foe[0] says "let it ramp to 2 stacks so it yanks him onto you". Riot's text: "If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled." There are no stacks — it is a shackle duration — and the pull moves Jayce to Kled, not the reverse. That inverts the counterplay, because a Thundering Blow spent after the yank has already conceded the position it was meant to protect. MISSING ENTIRELY: Jousting, his 13/12/11/10/9s 550-range dash that recasts to dash back through the target, appears nowhere on the page in either layer, so the reader is told the trap is his only way in. Also added: Violent Tendencies is exactly four attacks then nothing for 9s (the page called it "rapid-hits" as if it were a state), and it is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the burst tell. Cooldowns added: Bear Trap 11/10/9/8/7s at 800 range, Jousting 13/12/11/10/9s, Violent Tendencies 13/12/11/10/9s, Chaaaaaaaarge!!! 140/125/110s at 3500/4000/4500 range. LEVEL CHART: 2+ items read Jayce directly above prose saying "This is where he takes over... Kled is a hard scaler", in a 48.99% matchup; Level 1 and Level 6 also read Jayce where the prose calls both even. Corrected to Skill/Jayce/Jayce/Skill/Skill/Skill/Kled.
